text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the specific movement disorder you are experiencing, such as tremors, stiffness, or involuntary movements, and when it started. Also, have you been diagnosed with any psychiatric conditions recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Tardive Dyskinesia secondary to Risperidone use. The patient's history of recent schizophrenia onset, initiation of a high-potency antipsychotic (risperidone) two months ago, and subsequent psychiatric improvement strongly point to medication-induced tardive dyskinesia as the cause of his new movement disorder. I am satisfied with the clinical evidence and will recommend immediate discontinuation of risperidone or a switch to an atypical antipsychotic with a lower risk profile, such as clozapine or quetiapine, along with close monitoring.
